item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.111
item.description:
Release v1.0.111 adds new permission-rule regex support, a one-time remote host session creation flag, and several MCP/plugin/workflow/session fixes. It also includes many terminal UI, rendering, and reliability fixes across /usage, /diff, /resume, search, paste handling, and startup/sign-in flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.106
item.description:
Release v1.0.106 adds inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, unified /settings/dashboard navigation, and several session/agent management improvements. It also includes many fixes for Windows, MCP/LSP/sandbox behavior, prompt editing, terminal rendering, and help/docs accuracy.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases
